title: NBA Preseason Daily Digest
subtitle: October 13, 2026 – Final Week Before Regular Season

items.headline: Kawhi Leonard Expected to Make Raptors Debut Tonight
items.summary: Kawhi Leonard is anticipated to play his first preseason game for the Toronto Raptors tonight against the New York Knicks, marking his return to the court with his new team. The Raptors recently reunited with Leonard in a significant offseason move.

items.headline: Kristaps Porzingis Meeting with Warriors Medical Staff Amid Undisclosed Injury
items.summary: Golden State Warriors big man Kristaps Porzingis is scheduled to meet with the team's medical staff today to assess his undisclosed health issue. His return timeline remains unclear, raising concerns as the regular season approaches.

items.headline: Warriors Dominate Lakers in Preseason Clash
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors secured a decisive 111-97 victory over the Los Angeles Lakers in their preseason matchup.

items.headline: Thunder Roll Past Nuggets
items.summary: Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Denver Nuggets with a commanding 124-94 performance.

items.headline: Jazz Hand Spurs Another Preseason Loss
items.summary: The Utah Jazz beat the San Antonio Spurs 119-109, as San Antonio continues its winless preseason campaign. Rookie Ja'Kobi Gillespie impressed for the Spurs with 25 points off the bench.

items.headline: Timberwolves Defeat Struggling Knicks
items.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves handed the New York Knicks a 122-104 loss, contributing to the Knicks' tough 0-3 start in preseason.

items.headline: Spurs Rookie Shines Off the Bench
items.summary: San Antonio Spurs second-round pick Ja'Kobi Gillespie delivered a standout performance with 25 points, 4 assists, and 3 steals in 25 minutes off the bench against the Jazz.

items.headline: Cavaliers at Magic
items.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers face the Orlando Magic in their final tune-up before the regular season begins.

items.headline: Knicks vs. Raptors: Kawhi's Anticipated Return
items.summary: The New York Knicks look for their first preseason win as they visit the Toronto Raptors, with Kawhi Leonard expected to make his debut for Toronto.

items.headline: Thunder Host Pacers
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder take on the Indiana Pacers. Both teams are managing player availability, with key Thunder players resting and Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton questionable.

items.headline: Lakers vs. Warriors in Vegas Showdown
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors meet again in Las Vegas for another preseason matchup.

items.headline: Trail Blazers at Kings
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers travel to Sacramento to face the Kings, with Sacramento getting key players like Domantas Sabonis back.

items.headline: Lakers Monitoring Key Injuries Ahead of Season
items.summary: The Lakers are managing several injury concerns, including center Kessler (jammed pinkie, recently returned to practice), Sexton (lower-leg issue), and Brandon Williams (foot contusion).

items.headline: Thunder Stars Resting; Multiple Players Questionable for Pacers Game
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder are expected to rest several key players, including Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jalen Williams, for tonight's game against the Pacers. Chet Holmgren (quadriceps) and Isaiah Hartenstein (ankle) are also dealing with reported issues.

items.headline: Spurs Dealing with Preseason Injuries, Wembanyama Expected Back
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs are without Tobias Harris (calf strain) for the entire preseason and rookie Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) indefinitely. However, Victor Wembanyama and other starters who rested on Monday are expected to return against Phoenix on Wednesday.

items.headline: Clippers Face Significant Injury Woes
items.summary: The LA Clippers are battling a lengthy injury list with Max Strus (partial plantar fascia tear) expected out four weeks, Jordan Miller (torn rotator cuff) out six months, and Brandon Ingram (partially torn Achilles) and Bradley Beal (knee swelling) also sidelined.
